approvedStyle.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is the edit target: a top-down pixel-art cell tower-defense map.
Make ONE tightly constrained palette edit: replace the black-looking very dark plum/near-black OUTLINES with warm brown outlines throughout this image, particularly the cream perimeter wall, both central rectangular tissue obstacle islands, cell separation outlines, and the outer contour of the three-cell jade core. Use clearly recognizable walnut/chestnut brown approximately #795039 as the main darkest outline, with #95684B for secondary edge shadows. The edge color must read BROWN at a glance, not near-black, burgundy, purple or gray. Keep enough contrast to define crisp silhouettes but make the outlines gentler and warmer.
Preserve the existing pale subdued perimeter tissue colors, cream rim highlights, quiet blush/lavender floor, coral/orange obstacle cells and jade core. Preserve every shape, size, location, pixel contour, frame, single left opening, and all map geometry. This is strictly an outline color replacement; do not redesign, thicken the borders, add detail, or increase saturation elsewhere. Preserve sharp square pixel clusters and stepped edges. No smoothing, antialiasing, blur, painterly gradients, text, UI, grid, objects or watermark. Output the full map with the same aspect ratio. Preview only.

largeMap.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one NEW LARGE top-down pixel-art board map for the cell tower-defense game 胞卫战. This is a larger explorable/buildable map, not simply an enlargement of the small map.
INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the APPROVED ART STYLE AND PALETTE reference only. Copy its warm brown outlines, pale low-saturation perimeter tissue, ivory membrane, quiet blush/lavender epithelial floor, peach/apricot cell obstacles and small jade-rimmed three-cell core. Image 2 is the authoritative SHAPE AND PLACEMENT guide for the new large map, not a style reference. Match its geometry accurately. Do not copy the first image's two-island layout.
Canvas landscape 15:11 aspect ratio; map is 30 columns by 22 rows, each logical cell is 24 native art pixels, native concept size 720x528. Render it as very crisp deliberately drawn pixel art enlarged nearest-neighbor, preferably 2880x2112 output. All pixels square, stepped contours, flat clusters of 3-4 shades per material. NO blur, antialiasing, soft shading or high-resolution painted details.
GEOMETRY: coordinate origin lower left; each tile's image-top coordinate is (21-y)*24. A single tidy perimeter occupies only the outermost one-cell strip, with exactly one left-middle wound entrance at cell(0,11). All other edges closed. Frame fills the canvas, no outside blank margin. Render the four separate rectangular tissue islands shown in guide, with small stepped corners and decorations tightly INSIDE their footprints:
A: x7..9 inclusive, y10..17 inclusive, 3x8 cells, upper-left tall island. Image pixel bounding box x168..240,y96..288.
B: x14..17,y4..6, 4x3 cells, short horizontal lower-middle island. Image x336..432,y360..432.
C: x20..22,y7..13, 3x7 cells, right-middle tall island. Image x480..552,y192..360.
D: x7..10,y3..5, 4x3 cells, short horizontal lower-left island. Image x168..264,y384..456.
Keep A and D visibly SEPARATE with a four-cell-high open gap. Four islands total, no extra islands. Preserve broad open placement space and connected walkable corridors around them. Obstacles are ivory membrane-enclosed collections of small peach and pink tissue cells, with gentle sage/ochre beads, and warm walnut-brown outlines (roughly #795039; never near-black or plum). No decorative protrusions or cast shadows outside the rectangular footprints.
Core: exactly ONE small jade-rimmed cluster of exactly THREE pink cells, centered on cell(25,11), image native center (612,252). It should be about 2x2 logical cells overall: on this large map smaller relative to canvas than in the small-map reference. Do not add other green cores. Left wound should be muted rose, clearly the one entrance.
STYLE HIERARCHY: Pale peripheral pink/peach tissue, subtle dusty mauve shadows and warm brown edging, no saturated red perimeter. A narrow orderly cream membrane rim along all boundaries. The playable floor is quiet pale peach-pink with flat broad low-contrast lavender seams; use more small simple epithelial patches than in the small-map reference to express increased area, no checkerboard or grid lines. Obstacles and core are clearly readable, clean and gently colored. The larger map should read spacious, not busier or overdecorated.
No towers, units, fixed tower pads, grid lines, paths, arrows, numbers, labels, text, UI or watermark. Output the full new map only.
largeMap.note: Geometry guide is a plan, not precise runtime collision alignment; generated output resolution is checked separately. Prompt's requested output size is not assumed.
